verdict.headline: Iran attacks US base in Jordan, hawkish Fed dissenters send stocks to worst day in months
verdict.label: BEARISH — SPX 7,316 below 7,380 threshold; triple shock: Iran IRGC missiles on Jordan base shatters ceasefire, FOMC 9-3 hawkish hold drives 30Y to 5.19% (18-yr high), META EPS misses by $1; MSFT Azure 43% beat the only morning offset
verdict.rationale_short: The session delivered a triple shock that tipped the regime to BEARISH for the first time in this framework. Iran's Revolutionary Guard launched ballistic missiles at US forces at Muwaffaq Salti Air Base and a CENTCOM centre in Jordan — all intercepted, but Trump's 'hit them hard' language formally shattered the ceasefire pause that had briefly cleared Brent below $85 on Tuesday; Brent closed at $90.74 (+7.9%), re-breaching the regime trigger. The FOMC voted 9-3 to hold at 3.50%–3.75% with Hammack, Kashkari, and Logan all dissenting for an immediate +25bps hike, driving the 30-year yield to 5.19% — its highest since 2007. META Q2 EPS came in at $6.18 versus the $7.18 estimate as operating margin collapsed 12 points to 31% on $31B of Q2 capex. The S&P 500 closed at 7,316, below the 7,380 BEARISH line for the first time. MSFT Azure at 43% constant-currency growth (beat of the critical 42% threshold, AH +7.57%) is the morning's only offset; AAPL and AMZN report AH Thursday and are the next clearing events. Setup into Thursday is bearish until Iran, 30Y at 18-year highs, and the META capex-ROI pattern resolve.

Buying the AH dip at $529 is catching a falling knife with no operating leverage pathway established.

bear_case: Counter-argument: MSFT Azure at 43% constant-currency growth is the definitive refutation of the circular financing thesis — if the AI demand driving Azure's 43% growth is real (Azure's external customer base is not NVDA-funded), then the concern that AI infrastructure investment is circular and unsustainable is overstated. Iran's missile attack on Jordan was fully intercepted with no US casualties reported, and Trump's 'hit them hard' language is consistent with past posturing that has not produced open military escalation. The ceasefire framework can be quickly reinstated if both parties return to the Oman channel. META's margin collapse is a company-specific capital allocation decision — not a demand signal that AI infrastructure spending is about to contract across the sector. Tomorrow's catalysts (AAPL Q2, AMZN AWS, Q2 GDP preliminary read) could all surprise positively, and MSFT's +7.57% AH gap is a real morning lift for technology. If SPX reclaims 7,380 on Thursday's close, AND AAPL beats China iPhone consensus, AND AMZN AWS confirms AI inference demand above 30%, the BEARISH conversion is a single-session false signal and the regime flips back to HOLD.
